description: Documents published on EUR-Lex in the last N days (default 7), newest first, optionally filtered (e.g. what was published this week). Cost: 3 credits per 10 results of limit (default 20 → 6; clamped to the plan); an unfiltered request is usually answered by one query for 3 credits.

domain.description: EUR-Lex collection. NATIONAL_LAW is EUR-Lex's own collection; member-state law is in the lex_national_* tools.

language.description: Keep documents available in this language (default en).

subdomain.description: EUR-Lex sub-collection; the national case-law value is EUR-Lex's own collection, not the lex_national_* tools.

name: lex_recent_documents
title: Recently published EU documents
